result.title: Beyond Expert Replay: Cross-Instruction Anchoring for Continual Vision-Language-Action Learning
result.comment: 19 pages, 12 figures, 10 tables, including supplementary material
result.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models need to continually acquire new manipulation skills while retaining the ability to follow previously learned instructions. Experience replay (ER) can mitigate catastrophic forgetting, but retaining only a small number of historical expert frames per task leaves many old-instruction responses without direct supervision. Under limited replay, we observe a structured failure mode in which an earlier instruction can trigger a subsequently learned, competing goal. To address this gap, we propose Cross-Instruction Anchoring (XIA), which supplements expert replay with instruction-conditioned response preservation. At each task boundary, XIA freezes the previous policy as a teacher and matches its responses to old instructions paired with current observations. This extends supervision beyond stored historical examples without requiring additional expert replay data. Experiments across multiple VLA architectures and three LIBERO suites demonstrate improved success rates and reduced forgetting compared with ER under identical historical expert-data budgets. Additional RoboCasa and real-world experiments further support the effectiveness of XIA.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 VLA 模型在有限经验回放下出现的「旧指令触发新学竞争目标」失效模式，提出 Cross-Instruction Anchoring：在任务边界冻结旧策略作教师，用当前观测配对旧指令并匹配其响应，从而在不增加专家回放数据的情况下扩展监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作不研究 latent 视觉推理，但其「指令—目标绑定被覆盖」的诊断与冻结教师响应锚定，可能为 LVR 中任务必要信息在内部状态中的保持、跨指令干扰及监督分配提供可核查线索。
